name: AI Rivals Begin Coordinating on Safety
tagline: 100 things to know about OpenAI, Anthropic and Google DeepMind discussing shared AI-safety work while regulation and antitrust questions remain open.
description: A 100-card ScrollAI daily news pack on the September 16, 2026 story that OpenAI says it has been working with Anthropic and Google DeepMind on AI-safety measures, amid broader calls for capability-based safeguards, independent evaluation and clearer rules for frontier AI.
